Honestly, to me a link that's the same page but with a trailing slash or some tracking junk on the end is the "same" bookmark, so ideally the app would recognize it and take me to edit the existing one rather than make a near-duplicate — that's the same spirit as catching an exact repeat.

That said, I don't want to over-engineer this. A section marker that jumps to a different part of a page I could see being treated as its own thing, and I won't insist you nail every variation of a messy address. The important part — pasting the same link again lands me on the existing bookmark — is already covered. If tidying up trailing slashes and tracking bits is straightforward, I'd welcome it; if it's fiddly, it's fine to leave as a later refinement.
